name: Bandaram Pharma Packtech Limited
about: Bandaram Pharma Packtech Limited operates in the paper industry in India. The company engages in the processing and supply of recycled wastepaper; and trading of paper board. It also supplies various categories of recycled paper to small and medium-size paper mills. The company was formerly known as Shiva Medicare Limited and changed its name to Bandaram Pharma Packtech Limited in March 2022. Bandaram Pharma Packtech Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
